card.name: Digits inside dose table numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 2, 1, 3 or 4, that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number in dosing tables. It usually comes just after a unit such as m 2, mg or kg and just before mg, mL or units.

modes.label: Digit after body surface area
modes.description: The first digit of a dose that follows a body surface area value such as m 2.
